packages.name: HexForge
packages.author: Strata Core Labs
packages.description: High-speed binary & hexadecimal file inspector with WASM-accelerated FNV-1a checksums, Shannon entropy analysis, ASCII decoding, and live byte patching directly on the Linux filesystem.

packages.name: PixelSynth
packages.author: Demoscene Collective
packages.description: Interactive WebAssembly procedural pixel & plasma framebuffer synthesizer. Computes 60fps RGBA pixel buffers in linear WASM memory with adjustable frequency, phase, palette, and frame export to Linux FS.

packages.name: CalcWASM
packages.author: WASI Foundation Contrib
packages.description: Fast WASI command-line scientific & bitwise expression evaluator. Run directly from Strata Terminal via `calcwasm "2^16 + sqrt(144)"` or `strataget run calcwasm`.

packages.name: MarkView
packages.author: Strata Docs Team
packages.description: Live split-pane Markdown studio and document previewer that reads and writes `.md` files directly from `/root`, `/home`, and `/etc` with WASM-powered document metrics.

packages.name: JSONLab
packages.author: Strata Core Labs
packages.description: High-speed JSON workbench for formatting, path querying, tree inspection, diffing, and editing Linux configuration files (`/etc/strata/installed.json`, `/etc/strata/registry.json`).
